name: bld4_isometry_compact_uniform_recurrence
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : Isometry f) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ x : X, dist (f^[n] x) x < ε
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : Isometry f) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε), ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ x : X, dist (f^[n] x) x < ε
informal: Uses Mathlib2.lib_compactSpace_exists_lt_and_dist_lt: take a finite ε/3-net t of X and apply the lemma in the compact space Y = (t → X) (sup metric) to u k = fun i => f^[k] i, getting m < n' with dist (f^[m] i) (f^[n'] i) < ε/3 for all i ∈ t. With n = n' − m, the isometry property gives dist i (f^[n] i) < ε/3 on the net, and the triangle inequality (f^[n] is an isometry) gives dist (f^[n] x) x < ε for all x.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), Isometry f → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ ∀ (x : X), dist (f^[n] x) x < ε
